notes: Points only. Southern frontier Hiera Sycaminos (−20 to 284), then First Cataract (from Diocletian). No sourced northern/western lines.

properties.label_detail_en: Roman central government established in Alexandria, "which now became the capital instead of Memphis" (GHA II p.210).
properties.label_detail_ar: أُقيمت الحكومة المركزية الرومانية في الإسكندرية «التي صارت العاصمة بدلاً من منف» (ص210). [Arabic text pending native-speaker review.]

properties.label_detail_en: After Petronius, "the frontier between the Roman and Meroitic empires was fixed at Hiera Sycaminos (Muharraqa)" (GHA II p.290; p.208). Start −20 follows this dataset's Meroitic extent (Samos treaty); end 284 = Diocletian's accession (GHA gives only his reign).
properties.label_detail_ar: «ثُبّتت الحدود بين الإمبراطوريتين الرومانية والمروية عند المحرّقة» (تاريخ أفريقيا العام II ص290، 208). [Arabic text pending native-speaker review.]

properties.label_detail_en: Diocletian (284–305) "gave up Nubia" (GHA II p.215) and "pulled back the frontier to the First Cataract" towards the end of the 3rd century (p.294). Other works date this to 298; shown here from 284 (reign start) as a different tradition, low.
properties.label_detail_ar: تخلى دقلديانوس (284–305) عن النوبة وأعاد الحدود إلى الشلال الأول (ص215، 294). يؤرخها آخرون بعام 298. [Arabic text pending native-speaker review.]
